Meet Your Quest Master

Mr. Upendra Chaudhary

Founder, YourStories Wedding Planners

Upendra Chaudhary founded YourStories in September 2019 with a simple belief: wedding planning should feel like an adventure, not a chore. Based in Agra, he's spent years building a team that plans every ritual — from the first mehndi dot to the final farewell — with the same energy and care as a family member would.

Since 2019, that vision has grown into weddings across Agra, Delhi NCR, Bhopal, Indore, Mathura, and Bharatpur, each one carrying his hands-on approach: every couple gets his direct attention, not just a coordinator's checklist.

The Wedding Quest Map

Six Levels. One Unforgettable Wedding.

💍
Level 1

The Proposal Plan

We map your vision, budget, and dates — then hand you a personalised game plan for the whole celebration, from Agra to wherever your guests are flying in from.

🌿
Level 2

Mehndi Magic

Vibrant décor, live music, and a henna setup your guests will be posting about for weeks. Every colour chosen to pop in every photo.

💃
Level 3

Sangeet Spectacle

Choreography, lighting, and a stage that turns family performances into main-character moments. This is the level everyone remembers.

🐎
Level 4

Baraat Grand Entry

The entrance. Band, dhol, decorated ride, fireworks-safe lighting — a boss-level arrival that sets the tone for the whole day.

🔥
Level 5

Pheras & Vows

The heart of the quest. Traditional rituals handled with precision, priests coordinated, and a mandap designed to feel sacred and stunning.

👑
Level 6 · Final Boss

Reception Royale

Fine dining, curated entertainment, and a send-off that closes the quest in style. Achievement unlocked: happily ever after.
